description: This Java class defines utility methods for creating Akka stream sinks from consumers and bi-consumers that handle 'WithSender' messages, enabling integration with actor-based message processing.

classes.name: Consume
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to create Akka stream sinks from consumers and bi-consumers working with 'WithSender' messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an Akka stream sink from a consumer that processes 'WithSender' messages, supporting covariance via casting.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an Akka stream sink from a bi-consumer that processes message and sender pairs.

methods.name: untyped
methods.description: Creates an untyped sink from a consumer that accepts any 'WithSender' message.
